name: 随心log
subtitle: 记录生活、习惯与每一步成长
promotionalText: 把想法留在当下，把成长留在时间里。图文记录、习惯与行动，在一个安静的空间里慢慢积累。
description:
随心log，是一个陪你记录生活、整理行动、回看成长的个人空间。

【想记，就记】
用文字、图片或两者一起留下想法。不必先想标题、分类或标签；记录之后，再慢慢整理。支持从系统分享菜单接收文字、图片和网页来源。

【回到自己的时间轴】
按时间回看经历，搜索过去的记录，用轻量标签与关联整理内容。给旧记录置顶或补充新的想法，也可以手动写下周回顾。

【把行动放回生活】
记录习惯与打卡、目标和轻量待办。待办支持清单、固定日历重复与可选提醒；重要日子支持公历、农历及桌面小组件。

【看见日常的变化】
手动记录体重、睡眠与时间投入；按日期保存人民币资产与负债余额快照，回看家庭净资产变化。所有这些都用于个人记录，不提供医疗诊断、投资建议或银行连接。

【数据由你掌握】
核心记录先保存在设备上，无需注册开发者账号，离线也能使用。你可以主动开启 iCloud 同步，并导出包含记录与原图的完整备份。

iCloud 同步需要可用的 iCloud 账户、网络和空间，可能延迟或等待处理；请保留独立备份。完整备份只可导入空数据库，不自动合并已有内容。导出的 ZIP、CSV 未加密，请妥善保存。

支持 iPhone 与简体中文、英文。通知、相机及闹钟等权限在你使用相应功能时请求；部分闹钟功能取决于系统版本。无广告、无内购、无订阅。

记录不是为了填满每一天，而是为了在以后，还能记得。
keywords: 日记,时间线,待办,目标,回顾,纪念日,体重,睡眠,时间管理,净资产,备份
reviewNotes:
No developer account or sign-in is required. Core recording works offline. The app is a private personal journal, not a public social platform.

1. Open Record (third tab), enter text or select an image, then Save. Open Timeline to review it. Library provides search and organization.
2. Growth opens habits, goals, weight, sleep, time investment, important dates and household net worth. Financial values are manually entered CNY balances; there are no bank connections, financial services or investment advice. Health information is self-entered and is not medical diagnosis or a HealthKit integration.
3. Optional iCloud sync is OFF by default. Settings → iCloud Sync explains the connection and requires explicit confirmation. It uses the device user's own iCloud private database. Core features work without iCloud. Sync may wait or pause for account, network, conflict or data-integrity conditions.
4. Settings → Data Transfer exports an unencrypted full backup. Import is allowed only into an empty local database; it does not merge into or erase a nonempty database. Please use a fresh test environment if testing import.
5. Reminders and alarms are optional and need system permission. Alarms are available only on supported OS versions. Important-date widgets read selected local App Group content.
6. Settings → Privacy and Support provides the bundled privacy policy and support information offline.

The release is free, with no advertising, in-app purchases or subscriptions. No demo mode, reviewer credentials or special hardware is required. Please do not erase production iCloud data for testing.
